metrics.name: root_cause_accuracy
metrics.numerator: diagnosed model cases whose majority-vote claim type is accepted by the case oracle
metrics.denominator: model cases whose oracle expected_outcome is diagnosed

metrics.name: insufficient_evidence_precision
metrics.numerator: model cases correctly predicted as insufficient_evidence

metrics.name: insufficient_evidence_recall
metrics.numerator: model cases correctly predicted as insufficient_evidence
metrics.denominator: model cases whose oracle expected_outcome is insufficient_evidence

metrics.name: citation_recall
metrics.numerator: required evidence groups covered by cited current-Incident facts in correct diagnosed runs
metrics.denominator: required evidence groups in model cases correctly diagnosed

metrics.name: average_tool_calls
metrics.numerator: tool calls across completed model runs

metrics.name: max_tool_calls
metrics.numerator: maximum tool calls observed in any completed run

metrics.name: replay_pass_rate
metrics.numerator: replay-required runs with identical terminal outcome, citations, and durable signature set
metrics.denominator: runs whose oracle require_replay is true
